scientific_integrity: Proof is complete for the specified model. Finite checks independently verify exact moment identities but are not used as universal proof. Earlier percolation and epidemic-equivalence results are credited. Priority cannot be guaranteed without an exhaustive literature review.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion is for finite connected undirected graphs with a uniformly chosen seed and independent equal-probability bond retention; not for general SIR models, heterogeneous transmissibility, conditional variances or temporal outbreaks. The 3/4 guarantee is sufficient and not claimed best possible. Crossover uniqueness is not claimed.
title: Every added contact reverses its effect on epidemic-size variance as transmissibility rises
